mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits CYP3A4, significantly reducing simvastatin metabolism and increasing statin levels, elevating risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis; additional concern for serotonergic effects and hypertensive crisis with certain drug combinations.
action: Avoid concurrent use or select alternative antidepressant; if combination necessary, use lowest simvastatin dose with close monitoring for muscle symptoms and elevated CK levels.
